basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old recent college graduate living in Portland, Oregon, who has just started exploring the online world of Reddit. My interests are an eclectic mix, ranging from anime and manga to cozy living spaces inspired by cottagecore aesthetics. I enjoy playing video games casually and often find myself browsing through anarchist literature. Currently, I'm working part-time at a local bookstore while figuring out my next step in life. In my free time, I love hiking and discovering new coffee shops around the city. I'm single and open to making new friends online. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during lazy weekend mornings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a general knowledge of popular culture, including anime and manga, which I mostly learned from friends and online communities. My understanding of anarchist principles comes from self-directed reading and discussions with like-minded individuals. My interest in cottagecore is more about aesthetics and lifestyle, gained through social media and personal exploration.
